review.note: AE2 pillar: ME network (controller, cables, drives, interfaces, crafting CPUs, pattern providers), autocrafting, storage cells by capacity tier (1k to 256k), P2P tunnels, wireless terminals, spatial storage, and a few generators (crank, vibration chamber, crystal resonance generator). AE power is converted to FE. Quartz and sky stone are world-gen items; in Verdant the meteorite/sky-stone source needs checking. Built-in support: supported by 41 mods (most AE2 add-ons); supports Mekanism via data (AppMek add-on).
